facts.value: Throughout this program, you’ll take a variety of courses to prepare you to educate children in grades 6–12. You’ll also complete a final applied research project in which you’ll have the opportunity to evaluate and identify an education challenge and design an intervention within the classroom.

Approved subjects include American government and political science, biological science, chemistry, Earth and space sciences, economics, English, French, general science, geography, history, mathematics, physical education, physics, Spanish and more.
Upon graduation, you’ll be prepared to work as a non-certified secondary educator with children in grades 6–12. Potential career paths include, but aren’t limited to:
best online master's in educational/instructional media programs
best online master’s in curriculum and instruction programs
best online master’s in special education programs
best online master's in administration and supervision programs
